name: Avariel
traits: Winged elf. Medium Humanoid (Elf). +4 Dexterity, −2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom. Land speed 30 ft.

Immune to magical sleep. +2 racial bonus on saves against enchantment spells and effects. Low-light vision. +2 racial Listen and Search. Passing within 5 ft. of a secret or concealed door grants a Search check as if actively looking.
Keen Sight grants +4 racial Spot in place of the standard Elf +2. Avariels also get +4 racial Jump.
Choose proficiency with rapier or longsword. Also proficient with lasso and bolas. These replace standard Elf weapon proficiencies, including bows.

Fly 50 ft. (average) when carrying a Medium load or less, wearing no heavy armor, and neither fatigued nor exhausted. The wings must have room to extend fully. A Run in flight must follow a straight line.
An Avariel dive works as a charge. Descend at least 30 ft. and use a piercing weapon. A hit deals double damage.
Average maneuverability requires at least 25 ft. of forward movement each round to stay aloft and provides no hover. Upward flight is at half speed, with a maximum ascent angle of 60 degrees.
Common, Elven, and the home region language are automatic. The Avariel region grants Auran and offers Damaran, Draconic, Giant, Rashemi, Sylvan, and Tuigan as bonus languages.
Favored class Cleric. No racial Hit Dice. LA +3 gives ECL 4 at one class level.
This 3.5 profile applies the book’s Avariel traits over the 3.5 core Elf and aerial movement rules. The book’s species-specific dive keeps its 30-ft. descent and piercing weapon.
